Package model

Interface Model

All Superinterfaces:
UnnamedPropertyChangeSubject
All Known Implementing Classes:
ModelManager
public interface Model extends UnnamedPropertyChangeSubject
Core application model interface responsible for order handling, menu management, and server communication. Acts as the central contract between ViewModel layer and backend logic.

Version:
